run_make_grpcio_tools: run the script to copy protobuf and protoc plugin sources into the grpcio_tools Python distribution directory
run_protobuf_submodule_commit_hash: run the function to get the git commit hash of the protobuf submodule HEAD
run_bazel_query: run a bazel query against the protobuf dependency tree using bazel_deps.sh
run_get_deps: run the function to gather protobuf C++ and proto file dependencies via bazel query
run_main: run the main entry point to copy source files and generate the protoc_lib_deps.py dependency file
